groups.sentence: Policies state their purpose or scope: to build frameworks, principles, guidelines and resources for responsible AI use.
The draft was shaped by consultation, feedback or public comment from faculty, students, staff and other stakeholders.
Administrators establish baseline policies and general principles for generative AI use, including academic integrity guidelines.
Everyone, including schools, instructors, students and stakeholder groups, has input into creating AI policies and guidance.
The policy states when it was first published, revised or updated, and what changed.
The AI policy is interim or still under review, and a fuller policy is being developed.
A named committee, task force or working group, convened or charged by university leaders, drafted the AI policy or guidance.
A named body approved, adopted, ratified or endorsed the AI policy, on a stated date.
Generative AI tools were used to help draft, edit or refine the policy document.
The guidance was adapted from or built on policies, frameworks or syllabus models from other institutions or groups.
The document was written without generative AI assistance.
